result.brief: 提出关键视觉证据引导的知识蒸馏框架，通过教师注意力动态筛选任务相关视觉 token 进行特征蒸馏，提升 VLM 跨模态推理且无推理开销。
result.reason: Distills VLM visual token representations via teacher attention, but targets model compression rather than world-model or unified understanding-generation objectives; transfer to representation learning is plausible but indirect.
